patronOf.pt-BR: Padroeiro da harmonia entre as raças

prayerExcerpt.en-US: O God, who led Saint Martin de Porres by the path of humility to heavenly glory
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ó Deus, que pelos caminhos da humildade conduzistes São Martinho à glória do céu

meta.face: A slender Afro-Peruvian man of about forty-five with warm medium-brown skin, close-cropped black hair tightly curled, clean-shaven, a broad nose and full lips, heavy-lidded dark eyes lowered in humility, and a gentle, quiet expression.
meta.basis: The 17th-century portrait in Lima thought to be from his lifetime or just after (clean-shaven, close dark hair), the 2016 facial reconstruction from his skull, and his parentage (a Spanish father and a freed mother of African and native descent). Broom and the dog, cat and mouse are his standard attributes.
